blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adapting Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to medical imaging via LoRA has become standard practice, yet model selection is guided almost entirely by downstream task metrics, treating backbones with similar performance as interchangeable. We investigate whether equal performance implies equal internal representational shift. We analyse four ViT-B/16 backbones, DINOv3, SigLIP2, MerMED-FM, and BiomedCLIP, pre-trained with different objectives (self-distillation vs. contrastive vision-language) and on different data domains (natural vs. medical images). We adapt each to brain tumour segmentation and evaluate on six datasets covering both segmentation and Alzheimer's disease classification. Using attention divergence, weight-change analysis, and activation patching, we find that the four models converge to similar segmentation performance (mean Dice 78-81%) through markedly different internal dynamics, yet diverge in cross-task transfer: segmentation adaptation improves Alzheimer's disease classification for DINOv3 but degrades it for the other three backbones. We reveal a dissociation between modification magnitude and causal importance: the most heavily modified layers are not the causally relevant ones, with early-to-mid layers identified as sufficient for segmentation recovery. Restricting LoRA to these layers matches or approaches full-layer segmentation while reducing classification degradation in the three affected backbones, providing a mechanistically grounded strategy that is more parameter-efficient and more robust than standard full-layer adaptation.
blocks.zh: 通过LORA对视觉基础模型(VFMs)进行医学成像的改造已经成为标准做法,然而模型选择几乎完全由下游任务度量表指导,将性能相似的骨干视为可互换. 我们调查平等业绩是否意味着平等的内部代表性转变。 我们分析了四个Vit-B/16主干线,即DINov3、SigLIP2、MerMED-FM和BiomedCLIP,这些主干线具有不同的目标(自我消化与对比视觉语言)和不同的数据域(自然与医疗图像)。 我们每个都适应脑肿瘤的分化, 并评估六个数据集, 包括分化和阿尔茨海默病的分类。 通过注意力差异分析、权重变化分析以及激活补丁,我们发现这四个模型通过显著不同的内部动态与相似的分化性能(平均Dice 78-81%)汇合在一起,然而在跨任务转移中却存在差异:分化适应可以改善DINov3的阿尔茨海默氏病分类,但可以降低其他三个骨干。 我们揭示了修改幅度与因果重要性之间的脱节:修改最多的层不是因果相关的层,早期到中间层被确认足以进行分解恢复. 将LORA限制在这些层次上,匹配或接近全层分化,同时减少三个受影响的骨干骨干部的分类退化,提供了一个基于机械的战略,比标准全层适应更具有参数效率,更强.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs), which are pretrained on large-scale image datasets, provide powerful visual feature encoders applicable to diverse downstream computer vision tasks [ 1 ] . Adapting them via Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become standard practice, with methods like LoRA [ 2 ] achieving competitive results across diverse data domains [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] at a fraction of full fine-tuning costs. In medical imaging tasks, such as brain tumour segmentation, LoRA-adapted foundation models now rival fully supervised baselines [ 10 , 11 ] . Given the numerous publicly available VFMs backbones [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] , choosing which backbone best serves the downstream task becomes a key design decision. Currently, model selection is guided almost entirely by downstream task metrics [ 16 ] ; i.e., two backbones that reach the same segmentation Dice score are treated as interchangeable. In this paper, we investigate an intriguing mechanistic question: whether equal performance implies equal internal representation shift, as differences in how models reshape their representations may expose hidden generalisability risks and point to different backbone-selection or fine-tuning strategies.
blocks.zh: Vision Foundation Models(VFMs),在大型图像数据集上进行预训,提供适用于多种下游计算机视觉任务的强大的视觉特征编码器[1]. 通过参数-有效微调(PEFT)加以调整已成为标准做法,LORA[2]等方法在各种数据领域[3、4、5、6、7、8、9]以完全微调成本的一小部分取得竞争结果。 在医学成像任务中,如脑肿瘤分化,LORA适应的基础模型现在与完全受监督的基线[10,11]竞争. 鉴于有许多公开的VFM主干线[12,13,14,15],选择哪一个主干线最能为下游任务服务,成为关键的设计决定. 目前,模型选择几乎完全受下游任务衡量标准的指导[16];即达到同一分区的两个骨干 骰子分数被视为可互换. 在本文中,我们调查了一个令人感兴趣的机械问题:平等业绩是否意味着平等的内部代表性转变,因为模型如何重塑其代表性的不同可能暴露出隐性的普遍性风险,并指出不同的骨干选择或微调战略。

blocks.en: In model deployment, a single backbone often serves multiple downstream tasks. A model whose representations degrade on one task while improving on another poses a deployment risk that task-specific evaluation cannot detect. Understanding how models adapt, not only how well they perform, is therefore necessary for informed backbone selection. Mechanistic interpretability tools developed for natural language and vision models [ 17 ] offer a principled way to characterise this representational shift and to identify which layers drive task performance.
blocks.zh: 在模型部署中,单一骨干常常服务于多个下游任务. 一种模式,其表述方式在一项任务上有所降低,而另一项任务则有所改进,这构成部署风险,具体任务评价无法发现。 因此,了解模型如何适应,而不仅仅是其表现如何,对于知情的骨干选择是必要的。 为自然语言和愿景模型开发的机械可解释性工具[17]提供了一个原则性的方法,用以描述这种代表性转变的特点,并确定哪些层面驱动任务绩效。

blocks.en: We study four ViT-B/16 backbones, comparing both pre-training objective (self-distillation vs. contrastive vision-language) and source domain (natural vs. medical images): DINOv3 [ 12 ] , SigLIP2 [ 13 ] , MerMED-FM [ 14 ] , and BiomedCLIP [ 15 ] . All four models are adapted via LoRA to brain tumour segmentation on multi-parametric MRI and evaluated across six datasets spanning three segmentation tasks (BraTS-GLI [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] , BraTS-Africa [ 21 ] , BraTS-PED [ 22 ] ) and three classification tasks (OASIS-1 [ 23 ] , ADNI binary, ADNI multi-class [ 24 ] ). We analyse the adaptation process through the lens of four complementary mechanistic tools: attention Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence [ 25 ] , LoRA weight-change ratios [ 2 ] , off-brain attention fraction, and layer-wise activation patching [ 26 ] . Guided by the mechanistic diagnosis, we further propose and validate an early-layer LoRA strategy that restricts adaptation to the layers identified as causally important.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了四个ViT-B/16主干,比较了训练前目标(自我消化与对比视觉语言)和源域(自然与医疗图像):DINov3 [12],SigLIP2 [13],MerMED-FM [14],和BiomedCLIP [15]. 所有4个模型都通过LORA在多参数核磁共振上进行脑肿瘤分解,并在6个数据集(BratS-GLI[18,19,20],BrATS-Africa[21],BrATS-PED[22])和3个分类任务(OASIS-1[23],ADNI二进制,ADNI多级[24])中进行评价。 我们通过四个互补的机械工具的视角来分析适应过程:注意詹森-沙农(JS)的偏差[25],LORA的权重变化比[2],大脑外的注意力分量,以及分层激活补丁[26]. 在机械学诊断的指导下,我们进一步提出并验证了早期LORA战略,即限制适应被确定为因果重要性的层次.

blocks.en: Our main findings are as follows. (i) Although the four backbones converge to similar segmentation performance after LoRA adaptation, they diverge substantially in cross-task classification transfer. Mechanistic analysis reveals that segmentation convergence masks fundamentally different representational shift profiles, and medical-domain pre-training confers no consistent segmentation advantage. (ii) The most heavily modified layers are not the causally important ones: activation patching consistently identifies early-to-mid layers as sufficient to recover full segmentation performance from a frozen encoder, while late-layer adaptation can damage cross-task transfer, as shown by the degraded linear probing classification performance. (iii) Restricting LoRA to early layers matches or approaches full-layer segmentation while improving classification performance relative to all-layer adaptation in the three backbones whose cross-task transfer degrades, providing a mechanistically grounded strategy that is both more parameter-efficient and more robust than adapting all layers.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要调查结果如下。 (i) 虽然四个主干在LORA适应后与类似的分化性能趋同,但它们在跨任务分类转移方面差别很大。 机械分析显示,分化趋同掩盖了根本不同的代表转移情况,医学领域培训前的分化没有一贯的优势。 (二)最重修改的层不是因果重要的层:激活补丁一致确定早期到中层,足以从冷冻编码器中恢复全部分解性能,而后层的适应可能损害跨任务转移,退化的线性探测分类性能就表明了这一点. (三)将LORA限制在早期的层位匹配或接近全层分化,同时相对于交叉任务转移退化的三根主干线的全层适应性,提高分类性能,提供一种基于机械的战略,既比所有层位的调整更具有参数效率,也更强.

blocks.en: Together, these findings suggest that integrating layer-wise interpretability tools with multi-task downstream assessment reveals adaptation risks invisible to standard metrics and motivates practical strategies that would not emerge from task-specific evaluation alone. While our study focuses on brain MRI, the analytical framework can be applied to any attention-based encoder and data domain.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,将分层可解释性工具与多任务下游评估相结合,揭示了标准衡量标准所看不到的适应风险,并激励了仅从具体任务评价中无法发现的实际战略。 虽然我们的研究侧重于脑磁共振,但分析框架可以适用于任何基于注意力的编码器和数据领域。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Adapting Vision Foundation Models to medical imaging via PEFT has grown rapidly in recent years. LoRA [ 2 ] and its variants have been applied to diverse segmentation tasks [ 3 , 4 ] , including brain tumours [ 10 , 8 ] . A common approach in the literature is adapting a single foundation model per study and evaluating it on diverse datasets within one single downstream task, treating the backbone as a fixed design choice justified by its performance metric. Comparative analyses across backbones remain limited to performance tables without examining how different pre-training paradigms shape the internal adaptation [ 5 , 6 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 近年来,通过PEFT使Vision基金会模型适应医学成像的发展迅速。 LoRA[2]及其变体已被应用于不同的分化任务[3,4],包括脑肿瘤[10,8]. 文献中的一种共同做法是调整每项研究的单一基础模型,并在一项下游工作范围内对各种数据集进行评价,将主干视为一种固定的设计选择,其性能衡量标准证明是合理的。 跨主干网的比较分析仍然限于业绩表,而没有审查不同培训前模式如何影响内部适应[5、6、27]。

blocks.en: Beyond downstream metrics, mechanistic interpretability offers tools to examine how models internally reorganise during adaptation, including attention analysis, probing, and causal interventions such as activation patching [ 17 , 26 ] . Recent work has begun applying these tools to LoRA-tuned models [ 28 ] , using mechanistic analysis to guide adapter placement [ 29 , 30 ] , to decode attention head behaviour under distribution shift [ 31 ] , and to disentangle clinical from class-agnostic features during few-shot adaptation [ 32 ] . These studies provide valuable insight into individual models but, by analysing a single backbone in isolation, cannot reveal whether the same adaptation procedure produces different internal dynamics across architectures. Furthermore, the connection between mechanistic diagnosis and a concrete change in adaptation strategy remains largely unexplored in the vision domain: a recent exception in NLP uses causal and geometric analysis to guide LoRA placement across layers [ 33 ] , but interpretability findings in medical imaging are still reported descriptively rather than validated through intervention. Our work addresses both gaps by comparing mechanistic profiles across four backbones and by using the diagnostic findings to motivate and test a layer-selective LoRA strategy.
blocks.zh: 除了下游的衡量标准外,机械可解释性还提供各种工具,用以审查模型在适应过程中如何在内部重组,包括注意力分析、探测和因果干预,如激活补丁[17、26]。 最近的工作开始将这些工具应用于LORA调试模型[28],利用机械分析来指导适配器的放置[29,30],解码分布移下的注意力头行为[31],并在几发调试中将临床与阶级不可知特征分离[32]. 这些研究对单个模型提供了宝贵的见解,但通过孤立地分析单一主干,无法揭示同一适应程序是否产生不同结构的内部动态。 此外,在视觉领域,机械诊断与适应战略的具体变化之间的联系基本上仍未得到探讨:NLP最近的一个例外是使用因果分析和几何分析来指导LORA的分层放置[33],但医疗成像中的可解释性结论仍然被报告为描述性的,而不是通过干预加以验证。 我们的工作通过比较四个支柱的机械概况,并利用诊断结论激励和测试层层选择性LORA战略,来弥补两个差距。

blocks.en: The question of which layers to adapt has also received attention. Some studies dynamically allocate rank budgets across layers [ 34 ] based on gradient-derived importance scores [ 35 , 36 , 37 ] , while domain-specific heuristics select layers using task performance proxies [ 5 ] or Fisher information [ 38 ] . These approaches tend to favour later layers, consistent with the intuition that deeper representations are more task-specific [ 39 , 40 ] . Our results show that activation patching identifies early-to-mid layers as causally sufficient for segmentation, and that restricting adaptation to these layers preserves cross-task transferability that full-layer adaptation can compromise. This finding motivates layer selection based on causal importance and multi-task evaluation rather than gradient magnitude.
blocks.zh: 调整哪些层次的问题也受到关注。 一些研究根据梯度得出的重要性分数[35,36,37],动态地将级别预算分配到各层[34],而特定域的休眠学则使用任务性能代词[5]或费舍尔信息[38]选择各层. 这些方法倾向于后几层,这与更深入的表述更符合任务特定性的直觉[39,40]是一致的. 我们的结果表明,激活补丁确定早期到中层在因果关系上足以进行分解,而将这些层的适应限制在这些层中,则保持了全层适应所能妥协的跨任务可转移性. 这一结论促使根据因果关系和多任务评价而不是梯度大小进行层层选择。

blocks.en: 3.1 Adaptation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.1 适应管道

blocks.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , we adapt four ViT-B/16 backbones [ 41 ] to brain image segmentation task. Four brain MRI modalities (T1n, T1c, T2w, T2f) are fused via a trainable 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution that maps these four input channels to three, matching the RGB input expected by all encoders. All four modalities carry complementary clinical information [ 42 ] , so we retain all of them and let the learned convolution determine the optimal combination. This fusion layer is initialised with uniform weights of 1 / 4 1/4 with no bias term, equivalent to average pooling, and trained end-to-end independently for each backbone to learn modality-specific contributions.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,我们调整了四个VIT-B/16主干线[41],以完成大脑图像分割任务。 四种脑磁共振模式(T1n,T1c,T2w,T2f)通过可列车的1×1 1\times 1演化,将这四个输入通道映射为3个,匹配所有编码器预期的RGB输入. 所有四种模式都包含补充临床信息[42],所以我们保留了所有模式,让所学的进化决定最佳组合. 这个聚变层被宣布为1 / 4 1/4的统一权重,没有偏差的术语,相当于平均集合,并且为每个主干独立训练端到端学习特定模式的贡献.

blocks.en: The ViT-B/16 encoder is kept frozen; adaptation is achieved through LoRA modules injected into each of the 12 transformer blocks. From the adapted encoder, we extract multi-scale representations by tapping four uniformly spaced blocks { 3 , 6 , 9 , 12 } \{3,6,9,12\} (1-indexed), each taken after the encoder’s final layer normalisation and reshaped from the token sequence into a 14 × 14 14\times 14 spatial feature map with 768 channels. The four maps are concatenated channel-wise into a 3072 3072 -channel representation, which a lightweight segmentation head (two 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutions separated by ReLU, 3072 → 256 → C 3072\rightarrow 256\rightarrow C classes) converts into a dense prediction, upsampled to the ground-truth resolution of 240 × 240 240\times 240 pixels. The LoRA modules and segmentation head are jointly trained with an equal-weight combination of Dice and cross-entropy loss.

blocks.en: We evaluate each backbone in two configurations: frozen , where no LoRA modules are applied, the four MRI modalities are mapped to three channels via average pooling, and only the segmentation head is trained; and adapted , which includes the trainable fusion convolution and LoRA modules described above. The trainable fusion convolution may contribute to absolute performance differences between configurations; however, all four backbones share the same architecture, so mechanistic comparisons across backbones remain controlled.
blocks.zh: 我们用两种配置来评价每个主干线:冷冻,没有应用LORA模块,通过平均集合将四个磁共振模式映射到三个渠道,并且只培训分块头;以及调整,包括上述可训练的聚变和LORA模块。 可训练的聚变进化可能促成配置之间的绝对性能差异;然而,所有四个骨干都具有相同的架构,因此各骨干之间的机械比较仍然受到控制.

blocks.en: 3.2 Mechanistic Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.2 机械分析

blocks.en: We analyse the adaptation process [ 43 ] through four complementary tools: (1) attention Jensen-Shannon (JS) divergence [ 25 ] , (2) LoRA weight-change ratio [ 2 ] , (3) off-brain attention fraction, and (4) layer-wise activation patching [ 26 ] . JS divergence and weight-change ratio quantify the magnitude of adaptation in output space and parameter space, respectively. As the LoRA update Δ ​ W Q = B Q ​ A Q \Delta W_{Q}=B_{Q}A_{Q} modifies the query projection, it directly alters the attention logits Q ⋅ K ⊤ Q\cdot K^{\top} , changing the resulting attention distribution. The weight-change ratio measures this modification in parameter space, while JS divergence measures its downstream effect on the attention pattern; together, they capture the same adaptation from complementary viewpoints. Off-brain attention fraction examines the adaptation cost by measuring how much frozen attention must be redirected toward task-relevant regions. Finally, activation patching isolates which layer adaptations causally drive task performance.

blocks.en: 3.3 Layer-Selective LoRA
blocks.zh: 3.3 层 - 选择性 LoRA

blocks.en: To check whether the causal importance patterns identified by activation patching translate into a practical adaptation strategy, we split the 12 transformer blocks at the midpoint, applying LoRA to blocks 1–6 ( early ) or 7–12 ( late ), alongside the default all (1–12). The same cut-off is used across all four backbones to test whether a single, model-agnostic configuration is viable rather than optimising the split point per backbone. In each configuration, LoRA modules are injected only into the selected blocks, with non-selected ones retaining their original frozen weights. The segmentation head and fusion convolution are trained from scratch for each configuration to ensure a fair comparison, so performance differences reflect the effect of the LoRA module placement.
blocks.zh: 为了检查通过激活补丁确认的因果关系模式是否转化为实用的适应策略,我们在中点将12个变压器块拆分,将LORA应用到区块1-6(早期)或7-12(晚),同时将默认全部(1-12)。 在所有四个骨干上都使用同样的截断来测试单一的模型不可知配置是否可行,而不是优化每个骨干上的分点. 在每个配置中,LORA模块只被注入到选定的区块中,非选定的区块保留原有的冷冻重量. 分化头部和聚变集合从零开始为每个配置进行训练,以确保公平比较,因此性能差异反映了LORA模块布置的效果.

blocks.en: 3.4 Linear Probing Classification
blocks.zh: 3.4 线性勘探分类

blocks.en: To further assess whether representations learned during segmentation transfer to an unrelated task, we evaluate each backbone on Alzheimer’s disease classification via linear probing [ 45 ] . Features are extracted from the final transformer block with layer normalisation applied, and the patch token sequence is mean-pooled into a single 768-dimensional vector per slice. The 2 ​ D 2D representations of all slices belonging to the same subject are then mean-pooled into a single subject-level representation. A logistic regression classifier is fitted on the training set and evaluated on the test set. During feature extraction, the LoRA-adapted segmentation encoder is used as a fixed feature extractor: the adapted weights (including LoRA modules) are loaded but not updated, so the features reflect the post-segmentation-adaptation representations without any further training.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1 Backbone Selection
blocks.zh: 4.1 后骨选择

blocks.en: We select four backbones analysing the self-supervised objective (self-distillation vs. contrastive vision-language) and the training data domain (natural vs. medical images). The self-distillation models are DINOv3 [ 12 ] , trained on ∼ \sim 1.7 billion natural images, and MerMED-FM [ 14 ] , trained on ∼ \sim 3.3 million medical images, spanning diverse clinical modalities but excluding MRI. The contrastive models are SigLIP2 [ 13 ] , trained on ∼ \sim 10 billion natural image-text pairs, and BiomedCLIP [ 15 ] , trained on ∼ \sim 15 million image-text pairs from the biomedical literature. All four share the ViT-B/16 architecture (with 12 layers), isolating the effect of pre-training configuration from architectural differences. We note that pre-training dataset scale differs by three orders of magnitude between natural-domain and medical-domain models; this confound is inherent to the available foundation models and should be considered when interpreting domain-related comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们选择四个骨干分析自我监督的目标(自我消化与对比视觉语言)和培训数据域(自然与医疗图像). 自我消化模型是DINOv3 [12], 训练了 \\sim 17亿自然图像, 和 MerMED-FM [14], 训练了 \\sim 330万医疗图像, 跨越了不同的临床模式,但不包括核磁共振。 对比模型有SigLIP2[13],训练了\\sim100亿的自然图像文本配对,BiomedCLIP[15],训练了\sim 1500万的生物医学文献图像文本配对. 所有四个都共享Vit-B/16架构(有12层),将训练前配置的效果与建筑差异隔离开来. 我们注意到,培训前数据集的尺度在自然域模型和医学域模型之间因三个数量级的不同而不同;这种混乱是现有基础模型所固有的,在解释与域有关的比较时应当加以考虑。

blocks.en: 4.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集

blocks.en:
For glioma tumour segmentation, models are adapted on the BraTS-GLI [ 18 , 20 , 19 ] adult glioma dataset using all four MRI modalities (T1n, T1c, T2w, T2f) as input. Segmentation is evaluated at the 2D slice level on three nested tumour sub-regions: whole tumour (WT), tumour core (TC, combining enhancing and necrotic cells), and enhancing tumour (ENH, active infiltrating cells).
The dataset comprises 153,105 153{,}105 2 2 D slices from 1,251 1{,}251 patients, with a patient-stratified 70/15/15 train/validation/test split. Out-of-distribution segmentation generalisation is evaluated on BraTS-Africa [ 21 ] ( 7,462 7{,}462 slices from 60 60 patients from Sub-Saharan African populations with glioma) and BraTS-PED [ 22 ] ( 11,923 11{,}923 slices from 99 99 pediatric patients with glioma), without any retraining. For the classification tasks, we use the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS-1) [ 23 ] ( 39,438 39{,}438 2 2 D slices from 416 416 subjects) and the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) datasets [ 24 ] ( 174,458 174{,}458 slices from 1,494 1{,}494 subjects), taking the first T1n scan per subject in case of a longitudinal study. We use the default L2 regularisation strength ( C = 1 C=1 ) without tuning, so no validation set is used; each cross-validation fold uses a subject-level 70/30 train/test split (Section 4.5 ). On OASIS-1, we perform binary Alzheimer’s disease classification, and on ADNI both binary (CN vs. AD) and 3-class (CN vs. MCI vs. AD) classification, where CN is the label for a scan from a Cognitively Normal study participant, MCI denotes Mild Cognitive Impairment, and AD represents the presence of Alzheimer’s Disease.

对于胶原瘤分解,模型在BrATS-GLI [18, 20, 19] 成人胶原瘤数据集上采用全部四种磁共振模式(T1n,T1c,T2w,T2f)作为输入. 在3个巢状肿瘤亚区(全肿瘤(WT),肿瘤核(TC,结合增强细胞和坏细胞))和增强肿瘤(ENH,活性渗入细胞)的2D切片级上对分化进行评估.

blocks.en: 4.3 Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 4.3 预处理

blocks.en: We applied volume-wise z-score normalisation, followed by 2 ​ D 2D slicing. For all datasets, the selected 2 ​ D 2D slices were obtained by discarding slices with less than 5 % 5\% non-zero pixels from the original 3 ​ D 3D volumes. We clipped each slice to [ − 3 , 3 ] [-3,3] , rescaled to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 . The slices were normalised following each backbone’s original pre-training protocol (ImageNet statistics for DINOv3 and MerMED-FM, backbone-specific statistics for SigLIP2, and OpenAI CLIP statistics for BiomedCLIP).
blocks.zh: 我们应用了量子的z分数正常化,然后是2 D 2D切片。 对于所有数据集,所选的2 D 2D切片都是通过丢弃在原3 D 3D卷中含量小于5% 5 X%的非零像素的切片获得的. 我们将每个切片剪到[−3,3][3,3],调整为[0,1][0,1],调整为224×224×224乘224. 切片按照每个主干最初的培训前协议(DINOv3和MerMED-FM的ImageNet统计、SigLIP2的骨干专用统计和BiomedCLIP的OpenAI CLIP统计)实现正常化。

blocks.en: 4.4 LoRA Adaptation Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.4 LoRA 适应执行详情

blocks.en: All trainable components (LoRA modules, fusion convolution, and segmentation head) are jointly trained for 50 epochs using the AdamW optimiser [ 46 ] with a batch size of 32 and weight decay of 0.05 0.05 . We use a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the LoRA modules and 10 − 3 10^{-3} for the fusion convolution and segmentation head. Each experiment is run on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU and repeated with 3 random seeds; segmentation results report mean ± \pm standard deviation across seeds, while classification results are additionally averaged across cross-validation folds.
blocks.zh: 所有可训练部件(LORA模块、聚变和分块头)都使用AdamW optimiser[46]号联合训练,批量尺寸32,重量衰减0.050.05。 我们用10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4 10 - 4 5 的学习率来计算LORA模块, 10 - 3 10 - 3 10 - 3 )来计算聚变和分裂头部。 每个实验都在一个单NVIDIA A100 GPU上运行,并用3个随机种子重复;分化结果报告表示±\pm标准差跨种子,而分类结果则在交叉验证折叠上额外平均.

blocks.en: 4.5 Linear Probing Classification Implementation
blocks.zh: 4.5 线性勘探分类的实施

blocks.en: In this task, only a logistic regression classifier is trained on the features extracted from each backbone, using L2-regularised logistic regression ( C = 1 C=1 ) with class-balanced weights and the L-BFGS solver [ 47 ] , with a maximum of 2,000 iterations. Since OASIS-1 and ADNI provide only single-modality T1 scans, the fusion convolution is not used during feature extraction; instead, the input channel is replicated to three channels and normalised with each backbone’s specific preprocessing. The logistic regression classifier uses a 3-fold Monte Carlo cross-validation evaluation. The results are averaged across folds and across encoder training seeds for the LoRA adaptations. The L-BFGS solver is deterministic, so no seeds were varied for the probe.
blocks.zh: 在这一任务中,只有后勤回归分类器就从每个骨干中提取的特性进行培训,使用L2-正规物流回归(C=1C=1),具有类平衡权重和L-BFGS解析器[47],最多2000个迭代. 由于OASIS-1和ADNI只提供单式T1扫描,在特性提取过程中不使用聚变分解;相反,输入通道被复制到三个通道,并与每个主干器的特定预处理正常化. 物流回归分类器使用3倍的蒙特卡洛交叉验证评价. 平均结果为LORA调整型的折叠式和编码器培训种子。 L-BFGS解析器具有确定性,因此探测器没有变种种子.

blocks.en: 5.1 Segmentation Performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 分块性能

blocks.en: Table 1 reports in-distribution segmentation on BraTS-GLI. Across all four backbones, LoRA adaptation yields substantial improvements over the frozen baseline, raising mean Dice by ∼ \sim 8–11% points regardless of the backbone. After adaptation, the four models converge to a narrow performance range (mean Dice ∼ \sim 78–81% at r = 8 r\!=\!8 ), despite their different pre-training configurations. DINOv3 achieves the highest and BiomedCLIP the lowest mean Dice in both the frozen and adapted settings, while SigLIP2 and MerMED-FM lie in between: frozen MerMED-FM outperforms frozen SigLIP2, and after adaptation the two differ by less than 0.5 points. Pre-training domain alone therefore does not determine the ranking. The rank ablation reveals negligible sensitivity: for each backbone, the difference between the best and worst rank is below ∼ \sim 1% in mean Dice, and the differences between ranks fall within the standard deviation across seeds, confirming that rank tuning is unnecessary for this task. We therefore fix r = 8 r=8 for all subsequent experiments, following the default configuration in [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 表1报告了BRATS-GLI的分散分布情况。 在所有四个主干线上,LORA的适应比冷冻基线大有改进,无论主干线如何,平均Dice上升了8-11%。 适应后,这四个型号会汇合到一个狭窄的性能范围(mean Dice ∼\sim 78–81% at r = 8 r\!=\!8),尽管它们有不同的训练前配置. DINOv3在冷冻和适应的环境下都实现了最高和BiomedCLIP最低的平均值Dice,而SigLIP2和MerMED-FM则位于:冷冻的MerMED-FM优于冷冻的SigLIP2之间,在适应后两者的差幅小于0.5分. 因此,单靠培训前领域不能决定排名。 排名衰减揭示出可忽略不计的灵敏度:对于每个骨干来说,最佳和最差排名的差别在平均值的\\sim 1%以下,排名之间的差别在跨种子的标准偏差范围内,证实了排名调和对于这项任务是不必要的. 因此,我们固定r=8 r=8 用于后续的所有实验,遵循[2]中的默认配置.

blocks.en: 5.2 Classification Cross-task Transfer
blocks.zh: 5.2 交叉任务转让

blocks.en: Table 3 evaluates whether representations learned during segmentation adaptation transfer to Alzheimer’s disease classification on OASIS-1 and ADNI. The four backbones exhibit divergent behaviours. DINOv3 is the only model for which LoRA adaptation benefits classification: AUC improves consistently across all three settings. For the remaining three backbones, adaptation harms classification to varying degrees [ 48 ] : MerMED-FM shows the largest drops (e.g. 0.878 to 0.830 AUC on OASIS-1), SigLIP2 degrades consistently across all settings, and BiomedCLIP remains approximately neutral on OASIS-1 but drops on ADNI. Notably, frozen MerMED-FM achieves the highest classification performance across all three settings, yet loses this advantage entirely after adaptation. This divergence in classification performance is not predicted by the segmentation metrics, where all four models perform similarly, carrying direct implications for multi-task deployment.
blocks.zh: 表3评估了OASIS-1和ADNI在分化适应转移至阿尔茨海默氏病分类过程中获得的表述。 四个支柱表现出不同的行为。 DINOv3是LORA适应效益分类的唯一模式: AUC在所有三种情况下都不断改进。 对于其余三个骨干,适应危害分类不同程度的[48]: MerMED-FM显示最大下降(如OASIS-1上的0.878至0.830 AUC),SigLIP2在所有环境中持续降解,BiomedCLIP在OASIS-1上保持大致中性,但在ADNI上下降. 值得注意的是,冻结的MerMED-FM在所有三种设置中都取得了最高的分类性能,但在适应后完全失去了这一优势. 分类业绩方面的这种差异没有通过分门别类的衡量尺度来预测,因为所有四个模型都具有类似的性能,对多任务部署具有直接影响。

blocks.en: 5.3 Per-Layer Mechanistic Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.3 机械分析

blocks.en: Figure 3 reveals that the convergent segmentation performance reported above conceals markedly different internal adaptation dynamics across the four backbones.
blocks.zh: 图3显示,上文报告的趋同分化性能掩盖了四个主干单位明显不同的内部适应动态。

blocks.en: Figure 3 (a) shows that all four models exhibit increasing attention JS divergence toward later layers, but with different magnitudes: DINOv3 remains the most stable (below 0.3 throughout), while SigLIP2 escalates steeply to ∼ 0.75 {\sim}0.75 at layer 12. MerMED-FM and BiomedCLIP fall between these extremes. This suggests that DINOv3 requires the least representational reorganisation to solve the segmentation task, consistent with its superior in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance (Tables 1 and 2 ). Conversely, models that undergo larger attention shifts risk overwriting representations useful for other tasks, which aligns with the classification degradation observed in Section 5.2 .
blocks.zh: 图3(a)显示,所有四种模型都显示出对后几层的日益关注,但程度不同:DINOv3仍然是最稳定的(整个0.3以下),而SigLIP2则在12层猛升到0.75 {\ → 0.75 → 。 这表明DINOv3要求最少的代表重组来解决分化任务,符合其优异的分化与分化性能(表1和表2). 相反,受到更大关注的模型转移了对其他任务有用的风险重叠表述,这与第5.2节所观察到的分类退化是一致的。

blocks.en: Figure 3 (b) shows a different grouping in parameter space: the two medical-domain models (MerMED-FM, BiomedCLIP) exhibit the highest weight-change ratios in later layers, while DINOv3 maintains the most uniform and lowest ratios across all layers. Notably, the grouping here follows pre-training domain rather than objective: both medical-domain models require disproportionately large late-layer updates despite their prior exposure to clinical images, suggesting that domain-relevant pre-training does not reduce the magnitude of adaptation needed for a specific downstream task.
blocks.zh: 图3(b)在参数空间中显示不同的分组:两种医学领域模型(MerMED-FM,BiomedCLIP)在后层显示最高的权重变化比,而DINOv3则在所有层保持最统一和最低的比例. 值得注意的是,此处的分组遵循的是培训前领域,而不是客观:两个医学领域模型尽管以前接触过临床图像,但仍需要大量晚期更新,这表明与领域相关的培训前培训不会减少具体下游任务所需的适应程度。

blocks.en: Figure 3 (c) provides context for the adaptation cost of each backbone. In the frozen encoders, the two medical-domain models (MerMED-FM, BiomedCLIP) allocate a lower fraction of their attention to off-brain patches than the natural-domain models (DINOv3, SigLIP2), particularly in middle-to-late layers, consistent with prior exposure to medical images during pre-training. Figure 4 illustrates this qualitatively: the frozen medical-domain models attend to anatomical structures, whereas the frozen natural-domain models distribute attention more diffusely across background regions. After LoRA, all four models redirect attention toward the tumour, but the amount of redistribution required varies across backbones. Taken together, panels (b) and (c) present an apparent paradox: the medical-domain models already attend to anatomically relevant regions yet require the largest parameter updates. This suggests that attending to the right regions is not sufficient [ 49 ] , as the quality of the underlying representations, rather than attention alignment alone, determines how efficiently a backbone can be adapted.
blocks.zh: 图3(c)提供了每个主干线的适应费用的背景。 在冷冻编码器中,两个医学领域模型(MerMED-FM,BiomedCLIP)将其注意力的一小部分分配给脑外补丁,低于自然领域模型(DINOv3,SigLIP2),尤其是中到上层,与之前在预训期间接触医学图像一致. 图4从质量上说明了这一点:冷冻的医学领域模型涉及解剖结构,而冷冻的自然领域模型则将注意力分散到背景区域。 在LORA之后,所有四个模型都将注意力转向肿瘤,但需要的再分配量因骨干而异. 总而言之,小组(b)和(c)是一个明显的矛盾:医学领域模型已经涉及解剖相关区域,但需要最大的参数更新。 这表明,关注适当的区域是不够的[49],因为基本陈述的质量,而不是仅仅关注的调整,决定了如何有效地调整骨干。

blocks.en: 5.4 Activation Patching Recovery Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 激活补丁恢复分析

blocks.en: Figure 5 presents activation patching results across all six evaluation datasets. For each layer ℓ \ell , the adapted encoder’s output at that depth is injected into an otherwise frozen forward pass; the resulting task metric indicates how much of the full adaptation benefit is recovered when adapted representations are available from depth ℓ \ell onward. In segmentation (panels a-c), a consistent pattern emerges: across all four backbones and three datasets, performance recovery is concentrated in the first half of the encoder (layers 1–6), with recovery declining in later layers. This stands in contrast with the mechanistic profiles in Figure 3 , where the largest JS divergence and weight-change ratios concentrate in layers 8–12, revealing a dissociation between modification magnitude and causal importance. A notable case is MerMED-FM, which exhibits negative recovery specifically at layer 7 across all three segmentation datasets and all seeds (9/9 conditions), meaning that injecting the adapted representation at this depth produces worse performance than the fully frozen encoder. This layer coincides with a × 4 \times 4 jump in the value-projection weight change ( ‖ Δ ​ W V ‖ \|\Delta W_{V}\| ) relative to the adjacent layer. This suggests that the large value-projection rewrite produces activations incompatible with the subsequent frozen blocks.
blocks.zh: 图5列出了所有六个评价数据集的激活补丁结果。 对于每层l\ell,经过调整的编码器在该深度的输出被注入原封不动的前进通道中;由此得出的任务指标表明,当经过调整的表示从深度l\ell上可以得到时,可以回收多少全部适应效益。 在分解(pagels a-c)中,出现了一种一致的模式:在所有四个主干线和三个数据集中,性能恢复集中在编码器的前半部分(层1-6),后层的恢复下降. 这与图3中的机械特征形成对比,图3中最大的联署材料差异和权重变化比率集中在第8至第12层,揭示了修改幅度与因果关系之间的脱节。 一个值得注意的例子是MerMED-FM,它在所有三个分块数据集和所有种子(9/9条件)的第7层特别显示负恢复,这意味着在这个深度注入经调整的表示比完全冷冻的编码器产生更差的性能。 此层与相邻层值- 预测重量变化中的 × 4\ 4\ 4 跳跃( ‖ W V ‖ \|\ \|\ Delta W_{ V}\| }\| V}\| }\| }\| ) )) 相匹配 。 这表明,大值投影重写会产生与随后冻结的区块不兼容的激活.

blocks.en: Classification (panels d-f) shows more heterogeneous patterns across backbones, but the overall trend is consistent: later layers tend to reduce rather than improve AUC for all four models. Taken together, the segmentation and classification patching results consistently point to the first half of the encoder as the causally important region, suggesting that restricting adaptation to early layers could preserve segmentation performance while mitigating classification degradation.
blocks.zh: 分类(panels d-f)显示各骨干体的形态比较不同,但总的趋势是一致的:后层倾向于减少而不是改进所有四种模型的AUC. 组合起来,分解和分类补丁结果一致指出编码器的前半部分是因果重要的区域,表明将适应限制在早期层可以保持分解性能,同时减缓分类退化.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Layer-selective LoRA performance across segmentation and classification datasets. Each backbone is evaluated with three LoRA configurations: early (blocks 1–6, diagonal hatching), all (blocks 1–12, solid fill), and late (blocks 7–12, dotted hatching). Black stars indicate frozen baseline performance; when absent, it falls below the plotted range. Upper row: mean Dice (%) on three segmentation datasets. Bottom row: AUC on three Alzheimer’s disease classification benchmarks. The rightmost column shows each model’s average across the three datasets in each task category.
blocks.zh: 图6:分解和分类数据集的层选择性LORA性能. 每个主干采用三种LORA配置进行评价:早期(区块1-6,对角孵化),全部(区块1-12-12,固体填充),晚(区块7-12,点点孵化). 黑星表示冻结的基线性能;缺席时,它会低于所规划的范围. 上行:在三个分区数据集上,平均为Dice(%). 下行:关于阿尔茨海默症的三个疾病分类基准的AUC. 最右边一栏显示每个模型在每个任务类别中三个数据集的平均值。

blocks.en: 5.5 Layer-Selective LoRA
blocks.zh: 5.5 层 - 选择性 LoRA

blocks.en: Figure 6 summarises performance across the three LoRA configurations ( early , all , late ) on all six datasets, with the frozen baseline marked as a black star where it falls within the plotted range. These experiments serve as a validation of the activation patching findings: if the early-layer recovery observed in Figure 5 merely reflected signal accumulation rather than genuine causal sufficiency, restricting LoRA to early layers would substantially degrade performance.
blocks.zh: 图6概括了所有六个数据集的三个LORA配置(早期,全部,晚期)的性能,冷冻基线标为黑星,位于绘图范围内. 这些实验是对激活补丁结果的验证:如果图5中观察到的早期恢复只是反映信号积累,而不是真正的因果充足性,将LORA限制在早期层会大幅度降解性能.

blocks.en: In segmentation (upper row), early-layer LoRA matches or approaches all-layer performance for all four backbones across the three datasets, while late-layer LoRA consistently underperforms both. This validates the activation patching finding that early-to-mid layers are causally sufficient for segmentation. DINOv3 exhibits the smallest variation across configurations, consistent with its more uniform mechanistic profile (Figure 3 , panels a and b).
blocks.zh: 在分化(上行)中,早期的LORA匹配或接近三个数据集所有四个主干线的全层性能,而后期的LORA则始终表现不佳. 这证实了激活补丁的发现,即早期到中层在因果关系上足以进行分割. DINOv3显示的配置差异最小,符合其更加统一的机械特征(图3,面板a和b)。

blocks.en: In classification (bottom row), the effect of layer selection is more pronounced. All-layer LoRA degrades classification relative to the frozen baseline for 3/4 backbones by up to ∼ {\sim} 6% AUC (Table 3 ); early-layer LoRA reduces this gap to ∼ {\sim} 3% or eliminates it entirely, and in some cases recovers or exceeds frozen performance. Late-layer LoRA, while occasionally outperforming all-layer adaptation, in the majority of the cases remains below early-layer performance and exhibits greater instability across datasets. This general pattern could suggest that the late-layer representational shift identified by activation patching may be responsible for the cross-task damage observed in Section 5.2 : by not adapting those layers, early-layer LoRA preserves the representations that classification relies on. DINOv3, however, is a clear outlier in the classification results, in five out of the six tasks, the all layer LoRA adaptation gives the best results. This is consistent with the classification results in Table 3 , where DINOv3 was the only backbone to show improved classification performance after LoRA adaptation.
blocks.zh: 在分类(下行)中,层选择的效果更为显著. 全层LORA相对3/4主干线的冷冻基线降解分级 最多 \ \ \ sim} 6%的AUC(表3),早期的LORA将这一差距缩小到~~~~~~3%或完全消除,在某些情况下恢复或超过冻结性能. 后层LORA虽然偶尔优于所有层面的适应,但在大多数情况下仍然低于前层的性能,并显示各数据集的不稳定性更大。 这种一般模式可能表明,通过激活补丁确定的后层代表转移可能对第5.2节所观察到的跨任务损害负责:由于不调整这些层,早期LORA保留了分类所依赖的表述。 然而,DINOv3在分类结果中是一个明显的偏差,在6项任务中的5项中,所有层的LORA适应都给出了最佳效果. 这与表3中的分类结果是一致的,其中DINOv3是唯一在LORA适应后显示分类性能改善的骨干.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Our results show that four backbones with comparable segmentation performance diverge substantially in cross-task classification transfer. Mechanistic analysis traces this divergence to different representational shift profiles and reveals a dissociation between modification magnitude and causal importance: the largest attention divergence and weight changes concentrate in later layers (Figure 3 ), yet activation patching identifies early-to-mid layers as causally sufficient for segmentation across all four backbones (Figure 5 ). The layer-selective LoRA experiments support this finding: restricting adaptation to early layers matches or approaches all-layer segmentation while mitigating the classification degradation that all-layer adaptation causes (Figure 6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,在跨任务分类转移方面,四个具有可比分化性能的骨干部门差别很大。 机械分析将这种差异追溯到不同的代表转移剖面,并揭示了修改量和因果重要性之间的脱节:最大的注意力差异和重量变化集中在后层(图3),然而激活补丁则确定早期到中间层在因果关系上足以分化到所有四个骨干(图5). 层选择性LORA实验支持这一结论:限制适应到早期层匹配或接近全层分化,同时减轻全层适应导致的分类退化(图6 )。

blocks.en: DINOv3 is the exception to this pattern. Although its later layers are also less causally important than its early ones, all-layer adaptation yields classification results similar to or better than early-layer adaptation, and DINOv3 is the only backbone whose classification performance improves after segmentation adaptation. Among the adapted models, it also shows the lowest JS divergence and weight-change ratios, the smallest variation across LoRA configurations, the highest mean Dice on all three segmentation datasets, and the best classification performance. This is compatible with the view that a smaller representational shift better preserves the representations that other tasks rely on. The relationship, however, is not deterministic: BiomedCLIP undergoes a substantial attention shift yet remains approximately neutral in classification on OASIS-1. The mechanistic tools are therefore best understood as diagnostics that reveal how a model adapts, rather than as direct predictors of downstream task performance.
blocks.zh: DINOv3是这种模式的例外. 虽然它的后层在因果关系上也不如早期重要,但全层适应产生与早期适应类似或更好的分类结果,DINOv3是唯一一个在分化适应后分类性能得到改善的骨干. 在经过调整的模型中,该模型还显示JS差异和权重变化比率最低,LORA配置中差异最小,所有三个分块数据集中平均骰子最高,分类性能最佳. 这符合这样一种观点,即较小的代表性转变能更好地保留其他任务所依赖的表述。 然而,这种关系并不具有决定意义:生物医学中心(BiomedCLIP)在注意力上发生了重大转变,但在OASIS-1的分类上仍然大致保持中立。 因此,机械工具最好被理解为揭示模型如何适应的诊断,而不是作为下游任务绩效的直接预测器.

blocks.en: In our experiments, medical-domain pre-training confers no consistent advantage for segmentation adaptation: after LoRA, DINOv3 achieves the highest and BiomedCLIP the lowest mean Dice on all three segmentation datasets, while MerMED-FM performs on par with SigLIP2. This is consistent with the hypothesis that representation quality scales with pre-training data diversity [ 50 ] , though dataset scale and pre-training objective vary simultaneously, preventing causal attribution to any single factor. Notably, the frozen medical-domain models already attend to anatomically relevant regions more than their natural-domain counterparts (Figures 3 c and 4 ), yet this initial advantage does not translate into superior adaptation performance, suggesting that where a model attends matters less than the quality of the representations it computes. In classification, the picture differs: frozen MerMED-FM achieves the highest AUC across all three settings, yet this advantage is entirely lost after segmentation adaptation, showing the largest classification drops among the four models.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验中,医学领域的前期训练没有给分化适应带来一致的优势:在LORA之后,DINOv3在所有三个分化数据集上都实现了最高和BiomedCLIP最低的平均值Dice,而MerMED-FM则与SigLIP2一样进行等效. 这符合一种假设,即具有培训前数据多样性的表示质量尺度[50],尽管数据集尺度和培训前目标同时不同,防止因果归属于任何单一因素. 值得注意的是,被冻结的医学领域模型已经比自然领域模型(图3c和图4)更关注解剖相关区域,但这种初始优势并没有转化为优异的适应性能,这表明当一个模型涉及的事项低于其计算出的表述质量时。 在分类上,画面不同:冷冻的MerMED-FM实现所有三种设置中最高的AUC,然而这一优势在分解适应后完全丧失,显示在四种模型中最大的分类下降.

blocks.en: Practical guidelines. While our study is limited to four backbones and one imaging domain, the results suggest some considerations for selecting and adapting VFMs for medical imaging. First, backbone selection should not rely on segmentation metrics alone: evaluating on at least one additional task can reveal cross-task degradation invisible to Dice scores. Second, per-layer mechanistic profiles, particularly JS divergence and weight-change ratios, can serve as low-cost diagnostics before out-of-distribution data is available: in our experiments, the backbone with the most uniform and lowest divergence profile (DINOv3) consistently exhibited the best generalisation. Third, restricting LoRA to early-to-mid layers might be a conservative default when cross-task robustness matters, as it matched or approached full-layer segmentation for all four backbones while reducing classification degradation in 3/4 of them. Finally, we found no evidence that medical-domain pre-training provides an advantage over natural-domain pre-training for segmentation adaptation, though this comparison is confounded by dataset scale and should not be taken as a general conclusion.
blocks.zh: 实用准则。 虽然我们的研究仅限于四个主干和一个成像领域,但研究结果表明,在选择和改造用于医学成像的VFM方面有一些考虑。 第一,骨干选择不应仅依靠分化度量:至少对一项额外任务进行评价可以发现跨任务退化对Dice分数来说是看不见的. 第二,每个层次的机械剖面,特别是联署材料的差异和权重变化比率,在获得分配外数据之前,可以作为低成本的诊断:在我们的实验中,最统一和最低的差异剖面(DINOv3)的骨干一直表现出最好的概括。 第三,将LORA限制在早期到中间层可能是一种保守的缺省,因为跨任务稳健性很重要,因为它对所有四个骨干都匹配或接近全层分化,同时减少其中3/4的分类降解。 最后,我们没有发现任何证据表明医学领域预培训比自然领域预培训更有利于分解适应,尽管这种比较被数据集尺度所混淆,不应作为一般结论。

blocks.en: Limitations & Future Work. Our study is restricted to the brain MRI domain, to evaluating only four backbone models, to LoRA as the sole PEFT method, and to the ViT-B/16 architecture. In addition, whether the observed patterns generalise to other imaging modalities, adaptation strategies (e.g. adapters, prompt tuning), and larger model sizes (e.g. ViT-L, ViT-H) remains an open question. Segmentation experiments use three random seeds and classification probes use three cross-validation folds, which suffices to establish the reported trends but limits the precision of variance estimates. Future work would involve extending this framework to additional architectures, scales, imaging domains, and PEFT methods.
blocks.zh: 限制和未来工作。 我们的研究仅限于脑磁共振领域,只评价四个骨干模型,洛拉作为唯一的PEFT方法,以及VIT-B/16架构. 此外,观测到的模式是否泛指其他成像模式,适应战略(如适配器,即时调制),以及更大的模型尺寸(如Vit-L,Vit-H),仍是一个未决问题. 分化实验使用三个随机种子,分类探测器使用三个交叉验证折叠,这足以确定报告的趋势,但限制了差异估计的精确性. 今后的工作将包括将这一框架扩大到其他结构、尺度、成像领域和PEFT方法。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We have presented a mechanistic evaluation of four LoRA-adapted vision encoders for brain MRI, combining layer-wise interpretability tools with multi-task downstream assessment across six datasets. Our analysis reveals three key findings: (1) segmentation convergence masks substantial divergence in classification transfer, with medical-domain pre-training conferring no consistent segmentation advantage in our setting; (2) the most heavily modified layers are not the causally important ones, with early-to-mid layers consistently identified as sufficient for segmentation recovery; and (3) restricting LoRA to these early layers matches or approaches full-layer segmentation while improving classification performance relative to all-layer adaptation in the three backbones whose cross-task performance degrades after adaptation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了对脑磁共振四个经LORA调整的视觉编码器的机械评估,将分层可解释性工具与六个数据集的多任务下游评估结合起来。 我们的分析揭示了三项关键结论:(1) 分化趋同掩盖了分类转移方面的巨大差异,医学领域在培训前没有给予我们环境中一致的分化优势;(2) 修改最多的层不是因果重要的层,早期到中间层始终被确定为足以进行分化恢复;(3) 将LORA限制在这些早期层的匹配或接近全层分化,同时改善三个主干部的分解性能,使其适应后交叉任务性能退化的全层分化。

blocks.en: Together, these findings support a practical protocol for adapting vision encoders in clinical settings: evaluate on multiple tasks to detect cross-task degradation invisible to segmentation metrics, use activation patching to identify causally relevant layers, and adapt preferentially those layers to balance task performance with representational robustness. While our study focuses on brain MRI and LoRA, the analytical framework is applicable to any attention-based encoder and PEFT method.
blocks.zh: 这些结论共同支持在临床环境中调整视觉编码器的实用协议:评价多项任务,以检测分解度测量标准中看不见的跨任务退化,使用激活补丁来识别因果相关的层层,并优先调整这些层层,以平衡任务性能和代表性强性. 虽然我们的研究侧重于脑磁共振和LORA,但分析框架适用于任何基于注意力的编码器和PEFT方法。
